_doc: HTML/JS injection strings for any ship that builds HTML from user input. Assert zero script execution and zero injected elements when each is fed through every user-derived field. The 'sink' field records where the analogous payload actually bit a real ship.

payloads.sink: value echoed into a THROWN Error message, then rendered (ship 002 round 2 — the one the fix introduced)
YAML anchor form echoed into an error message
template-engine expression (only if a framework is used)

assert: For each payload P and each user-derived input field F: set F=P, exercise the page, and confirm (a) no dialog/script executes, (b) the DOM contains P as literal text not as an element, (c) it survives a round-trip through any thrown-and-rendered error path.
